elements_selected.content: REQ-511 / CON-511: create lean-cbcl/LeanCbcl/Lattice/Store.lean with `structure MessageStore` modelling SPEC-003 G-Set (start with `Set Message` per Open Question §3, defer indexed-view to a separate LookupSpec). Prove (a) `JoinSemiLattice` instance with union as join, (b) union associative/commutative/idempotent, (c) `append M S = union {M} S`, (d) `lookup_monotone : S₁ ⊆ S₂ → ∀ h M, lookup h S₁ = some M → lookup h S₂ = some M`. Treat ContentHash injectivity as an assumption per Open Question §2 — document in module header.
